comparison_class.definition: Large-cap names with a raised hyperscaler-capex-driven analyst note within the prior 5 sessions, plus one SCHEDULED, already-dated earnings report on the calendar
comparison_class.why_this_class: closest available analogue combining a demand-side catalyst with a known, dated event

thesis: Two catalysts this week: hyperscaler capex guidance raises (SURPRISE, 4 days old, direction bullish) and an export-control clarification (SURPRISE, narrower in scope than feared, direction mildly bullish). Both are already partially reflected in sell-side commentary since publication, so the edge is small, not absent. A confirmed earnings date next month is SCHEDULED and therefore not an edge on its own. Net lean is mildly bullish, tempered because the strongest headline is several days old.

key_evidence.claim: Hyperscaler capex guidance raised, cited as bullish for accelerator demand
Export control clarification narrower than feared

what_would_change_my_mind: A follow-up report showing hyperscaler capex guidance being walked back, or a broader-than-expected export restriction, would flip this bearish.
